coverage_of_sales_by_fork.note: Market sales (no giveaways, with a buyerTxId) classified by whether the fork tracks the listing's main sat (GET /sat/{mainSatoshi.rangeStart}).

palindrome_definitions_verified.method: Every sold palindromic main sat (8,596 distinct) checked against Magisat's per-sat sattributes, counting only sales after the tag first appears in the feed (tags were added during 2023, older snapshots lack them).

3d-pali.definition: 2 or 3 distinct digits (sold 2d palindromes carry 3d-pali too)
3d-pali.note: Magisat's totalSupply equals the exactly-3 count, its per-sat tag includes 2-digit ones

seq-pali.definition: a run of >= 3 identical consecutive digits
seq-pali.note: totals differ by 0.6%: an edge case of Magisat's rule is unknown

uniform-palinception.definition: the digits split into >= 2 equal-length blocks of length >= 3, each a palindrome

perfect-palinception.note: Magisat's total and circulating counts are both 137 higher (it apparently also counts repdigits)

pali-block.definition: palindromic sat number mined in a block whose height is a palindrome

sales_by_our_row.note: Market sales (no giveaways, with a buyerTxId) whose main sat falls in each fork row, by purchase year. A sale counts once per row of its main sat.

off_by_one_evidence.note: Sold sats that our types put in an exotic range only because of the inclusive range end (Magisat tags them plain uncommon/alpha).

previous_sat.note: the real last pizza sat of this range
